PR40.title: docs: M8 bounded engineering annex and actual process diagram
PR40.head: codex/documentation-m8
PR40.body:
M8 adds an AI engineering annex at fixed cutoff1005715ac5ae017a8d57b1af036a3c24c53862af and links it from AI-development-report/submission-map. It preserves the existing35-page technical Word set, M6/M7 33/35-page QA/manifests, requirements/design/AI-specification/test report Markdown and14 frozen files. No student research was authored.

The annex records stage07/08 limited whitebox/deliverable conclusions and the distinction between independently reviewed oldM6 33pages and currentM7 35pages; source-bundle9d6 red→add736 design→dda3 fix→6a32 limited closure without a new actual bundle; DB short ABBA and unintegrated db87 candidate520/89 CI with actual Docker merge checkout; native4ef failed360→c191/62ac→e301 frozen red/green+a7bad limited review→separate10182 successful360; usage synthetic observation limits and new v4 H/M freeze/authorization without new performance results. Historical failures, partial overrides/resource cost, source6307 and human evidence gaps remain.

One actual native process diagram was rendered to SVG/PNG with the existing pinned tool and isolated Chrome profiles. This AI opened the first and final original PNGs; the tall first layout is retained, final labels/arrows/edges are clean, and new Chrome process remainder0. The diagram distinguishes reviewer freeze-before-fix-reading from owner design/implementation order. No Word/marker, product test, service, CI or load was executed.

43 explicitly public source hashes,14 frozen hashes,64 unchanged application hashes, protected old report/QA/manifest bytes,32 relative links, JSON/SVG and secret/student-ID pattern checks passed. One public native question and its AI verbatim reply are saved. A clearly separate post-cutoff section uses only published dcad ready metadata:phase=serving/capability_ready=true, final exit/cleanup null; it does not claim complete4h or live connectivity. No H tree/cases/manifests/scripts/keys/ciphertext/raw outputs, tester worklog bodies, private Word/cover or R002 raw were read.

Design7b86047d4d09b8fe3a2710702e4ecef640edb275; implementation b974accc644ec897f59cb7e4ddf105e1027a7a8b. Sources/collection/validation:docs/reports/M8-source-manifest.json, M8-collection.json, M8-validation.json and diagrams/M8-render-manifest.json. Same-account COMMENT is not human approval; no approval/status/main merge or global acceptance.
